name: 79416 · Lubbock, TX
findings: ZIP 79416 (Lubbock) has 83 nonprofit organizations. 34 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 29 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 79416 (Lubbock) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 79416 (Lubbock) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 43% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 42 organizations here; 28% of all organizations here have no identified type.
